categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC method implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents file corruption and prune-lock collisions from concurrent dumptxoutset runs, and avoids expensive UTXO copying on stale target blocks. As noted in the summary, concurrent calls write to the same temporary file and clobber prune locks, while invalid rollback targets trigger full UTXO set copies before failing.
